title: Klara and the Sun
author: Kazuo Ishiguro
summary: Klara is a solar-powered companion robot who watches the world from a shop window until a sick teenage girl chooses her. As she tries to help her new family, she holds her own odd, devoted beliefs about the Sun.
readIf: you like gentle, understated fiction that sees human behaviour through an outsider's eyes.
skipIf: you want plot and answers, because the world is only lightly sketched and the story is very quiet.

pairings.reason: Same author and the same hush, with a made-for-purpose narrator and a very quiet sadness.
A warmer and more hopeful short story about a robot learning what people need.
A more clinical, puzzle-based set of stories about machines that care and the humans around them.
